sources.quote: Gemini 3 Flash is priced at $0.50/1M input tokens and $3/1M output tokens (audio input remains at $1/1M input tokens).
sources.supports: Google's announcement states the official Gemini API launch input and output prices.

sources.quote: Context caching price $0.05 (text / image / video)$0.10 (audio)$1.00 / 1,000,000 tokens per hour (storage price)
sources.supports: Google's pricing page lists the official cached input token price for Gemini 3 Flash Preview.
Google's developer guide associates the model ID with the $0.50/$3 price.

notes: The official Google launch announcement is dated Dec 17, 2025 and states $0.50/$3 pricing; Google’s pricing page lists $0.05 cache reads. This contradicts the earlier $0.15/$0.60/$0.0375 figures, so models.dev was correcting its own error. The Internet Archive CDX request returned HTTP 503, so no archived snapshot bracket could be obtained; Google’s sources do not state a more precise pricing effective time.
